description: This file provides support for the TogetherAI platform's integration with OpenAI's chat completion API, including configuration classes and parameter mapping functions.

classes.name: TogetherAIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for TogetherAI's OpenAI chat models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig with support for specific parameters and mappings.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines which OpenAI parameters are supported for a given model, removing unsupported parameters based on model capabilities.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps and modifies OpenAI parameters for compatibility with the model, specifically handling 'response_format' parameter adjustments.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
